p.bio: Saifullah competed in the World Match Racing Tour (WMRT) as bowman on Malaysia's Koo Racing Team (KRT). Their best ranking was 13th in the world (World Sailing Novermber 2016). Saifullah also competed in the WMRT M32 series. More recently he has been competing in the SB20 one-design class in Asia. He hails from Kuala Terengganu in the state of Terengganu.

c: SB20 Asian Grand Slam & Asia Pacific Championship 2023
